rule: Never mix geography grains in one visual
why: STATE, ZONE and NATIONAL are separate; summing them double-counts

rule: Never compare CPI index levels between jurisdictions
why: NBS prints the prohibition in the source; only change rates are comparable

rule: Food is ZONE grain only - six zones, never 37 jurisdictions
why: Hard source ceiling; no state-level food prices exist

rule: NERC tariffs are DisCo grain and a single July 2025 cross-section
why: Never mapped to a jurisdiction, never plotted as a time series
Single national series; never a jurisdiction metric

rule: Transport modes are never combined or averaged
why: A journey by air and by okada are different products

rule: Air and intercity bus are inter-regional, not local mobility
why: 83% of air's monthly variation is a common national movement

rule: LPG cylinder sizes are separate series
why: 5 kg and 12.5 kg are different products

rule: Where the order keeps changing, show the gap but name no jurisdiction as cheapest or dearest over time
why: Each single month's ranking is a valid snapshot; the order does not hold from month to month
Mixing publication semantics answers two questions at once

rule: Never interpolate across a known gap
why: CPI YoY has no 2026-02 rows; every YoY line must break
Normalisation and weighting have not been defined or approved

rule: Movement flags are descriptive, not action triggers
why: Whether a move matters needs cost exposure, margin and pass-through
LPG ends 2026-04; fuels and transport 2026-05; CPI 2026-07

rule: Cross-jurisdiction median is not a national statistic
why: Equally weighted median of 37 jurisdictions, never 'Nigeria average'
